title: Part 2: I opened the closet. I should have run 🚪
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, harsh high contrast lighting, sharp focus, 35mm film grain, realistic, dark apartment at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: Part 2. I opened the closet. I should have run.

scenes.narration: Part 2. I opened the closet. I should have run.

shots.prompt: wooden wardrobe door slightly open with warm yellow light inside, bedroom at night, no person

scenes.narration: The handle was warm. The door was heavy. Inside, my coats were gone. Just a bare floor and a cold draft.

shots.prompt: inside a wardrobe, hanging dark coats on a rail, warm lamp light, close view, no person

scenes.narration: In the middle sat a person. Back to me. Knees pulled up. Whispering into a phone. Whispering my exact words.

shots.prompt: silhouette of a person sitting cross-legged in a dark room, back to camera, one warm lamp, no face

scenes.narration: Don't open the closet. Whatever you hear, it's not me. I knew that voice. I had heard it every night in my own head.

shots.prompt: person in dark hoodie sitting on closet floor seen from behind, bright bare bulb above, well exposed, no face

scenes.narration: He did not turn around. He raised the phone over his shoulder. The screen showed a call to my number. It was ringing in my pocket.

shots.prompt: smartphone lying on a wooden floor, glowing screen lighting the boards, warm light, no text

scenes.narration: I answered. His voice came through my phone and, one second later, through his mouth. Same words. Same pause. A recording playing live.

shots.prompt: a hand holding a smartphone to an ear, bedroom, warm lamp light, blurred background, no face, no text

scenes.narration: Then he said, quietly, you were not supposed to open it. Now one of us has to stay.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom with an open wardrobe and a warm orange glow inside, no person

overlays.text: One of us has to stay.

scenes.narration: Behind me, the door swung shut. And I was sitting on the floor, a phone in my hand, whispering the warning to the next person.

shots.prompt: wardrobe door closing, bright orange strip of light along the edge, bedroom wall, no person

scenes.narration: So tell me. Would you have stayed, or run?

shots.prompt: wooden wardrobe door slightly open with warm yellow light inside, bedroom at night, no person
